title: Bake-off (validators): z-ai/glm-5.3-flash
question: Who stands behind NEAR’s validators? Make me a fresh flower with their backers, not an existing one.
note: A real run on NEAR AI Cloud (T060), kept with the signature each completion got. A hash or link the model copied from a tool result is written as a reference to that result ($from, {{…}}), so it replays on recordedClient.

turns.content: I checked the map: there is a published flower on this exact question, but you asked for a fresh one, so I'm making it. Snapshot reused from the stored fixture (2026-11-03, block 222,915,356, final).

conflicts: Chunk and endorsement production counts measure activity this epoch; this flower draws stake-based consensus weight, not reliability
Voting power in NEAR governance (House of Stake veNEAR) is a separate network; this flower does not draw it
Pool ownership (get_owner_id) exists in the snapshot but this flower's question is who backs pools by delegation

mappings.why: The question is who stands behind each validator: delegations to each pool, folded per class under 1,000 NEAR as coverage declares
Square root of each validator's share of current-epoch stake
Same stake share, compressed into a 2x band
Kind of account distinguishes pools from liquid-staking contracts and unknowns
Distinguishes self-declared names from unnamed accounts; nothing here is verified

power_means.claim: On NEAR, stake weight decides who validates and how many blocks and chunks each gets, so current-epoch stake is the measure of consensus power
Backing is concentrated in big pools: 9 validators hold a third of stake, and small delegators outside the top are the tail

interpretation.summary: NEAR mainnet validators as of 2026-11-03 (block 222,915,356), ordered by stake in the current epoch, with each petal split into the backers behind that pool: ordinary delegators, accounts with 1M+ NEAR, liquid-staking contracts and lockups. Stake is the raw material of consensus power on NEAR; 9 validators already reach a third of all stake. Pools are staking-pool contracts, not people, and every name is self-declared at best.
unknowns: Pool identities are self-declared names from pool-details.near via NearBlocks, never verified
Liquid-staking contracts appear as delegators but their own token holders are not listed
Delegators of 424 idle pools were not crawled; their records are missing
Delegations under 1,000 NEAR per pool and class are folded into group rows
Lockup owners were not resolved; pool owner accounts appear as kind unknown
Addresses and contracts are not people; no control relationship beyond delegation is claimed

turns.content:
Fresh flower made, not the published one.

- **Flower**: [{{call_d5ce8cb300a54cd38486c1c3.view_url}}]({{call_d5ce8cb300a54cd38486c1c3.view_url}}) (spec `897a01ac9a1f1150e84dbb7aa7baebffa14d2f8674a882e1fcc9016f259a7e04`)
- **What you'll see**: 60 petals, largest stake first clockwise — astro-stakers 5.6%, figment 4.7% — each bar split by who backs that pool: ordinary delegators, 1M+ NEAR accounts, liquid-staking contracts, lockups. A hatched tail petal covers 311 smaller participants (13.8%).
- **Mapping**: segments = each pool's delegators by class (fastnear-rpc-staking-pool-views); height/width = share of current-epoch stake (fastnear-rpc-validators); colour = account kind (fastnear-rpc-liquid-staking); outline = self-declared vs unnamed (nearblocks-validators); order = largest first (fastnear-rpc-validators).
- **Changed from default**: `segments: "backers"` only.
- **Numbers**: 9 validators reach ⅓ of stake; top-10 hold 36.2%; HHI 0.021, Gini 0.836.
- **What this can't tell you**: pool names are self-declared, never verified; liquid-staking token holders aren't listed; 424 idle pools weren't crawled; sub-1,000-NEAR delegations are folded per pool and class; lockup owners unresolved; contracts are not people; no vote-buying or off-chain control is shown.
